tei:div.tei:p: "$ (123)༄༅// dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'bring du bya ba yan lag drug pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(124)༄༅// na maḥshrī tsakra nā tha rat+na war+dhā ya/ kun khyab thabs la mkhas pa'i snying rje dang*// rnam kun mchog ldan 'od gsal shes rab che// dbyer med dges pa rdo rje la btud de// rgyal ba rigs drug sgrub thabs bshad kyis nyon// 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su nub mo chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du nyal/ tho rangs lha sku bde ba chen po'i nga rgyal gyis langs/ lam gyi grogs su 'gro na khrus bya/ mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la/ bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas kha shar phyogs su bltas te 'dug la/ skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur dmigs te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo// chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang (125)brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o//

zhes lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa (126)rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol// hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru ka'i sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas gshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra rdo rje khrag 'thung dam tshig rjes su skyong he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya*/ khrag 'thung nyid kyis nye bar gnas par mdzod/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍ-i ḍho bdag la brtan par mdzad du gsol me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa bdag la shin tu dges par mdzod me bha wa/ a nu rak+to bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ dag la shin tu rgyas par mdzod/ sarba sid+dhi m+me prā yats+tsha/2 bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol/ sarba karma su las kun la'ang bdag gi ni tsa me/ cit+taṃ shre sems la dge legs su ni mdzod

ya ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha bcom ldan rdo rje khrag 'thung du ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me bdag grol khrag 'thung nyid du mdzod muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā dam tshig sems dpa' chen po sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus kyi mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon (127)pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ rang skad cig gis dpal kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po// de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kye rdo rje'i lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu la brgyan pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma shrī he badz+ra maṇ+ḍal le bh+yaḥ snying ga'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams te/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom kun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni (128)bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ ces lan gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// (129)dbugs ma byung ba dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig

/nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig / ces brjod/ chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi snang ba/ de yang rang rig pa sgyu ma lta bu/ de yang rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du shes par byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba/ stod rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ bh+rūṃ ser po las 'khor lo ser po// rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa/ yang shing rgya che ba go skabs med par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra ra k+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūṃ hūm̐/ lan gsum/ 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du bh+rūṃ ser po// phyogs bcur nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ de yang lho'i dkar po// nub kyi dmar po/ gzhan thams cad sngon po/ de thams cad so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor (130)'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje'i gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa// lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/

lho nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa// nub byang du stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du hūm̐ mdzad sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ hūm̐ mdzad ma yin pa gzhan thams cad phyag g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'byar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams brjid pa'i khro bo ste/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bgrad pa/ sku sbom zhing thung ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang*/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ khro bo gzhan rnams ni mdzes pa'i khro bo ste/ cung zad sgeg cing yid tsam khros pa/ sku skems shing grim pa/ dbu skra nag po/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la (131)phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma// spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo bcu gcig srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spro na sngar bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'am/ rgyas par na 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags rgyas bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spro na gong ltar mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rābha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lus gshin rje'i gshed la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rdo rje phra mo dpag tu med pas gtam par bsam/ hūm̐ de nyid rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa gcig tu gyur te/ de yi lte ba stong par yod pa'i nang du rang gi sems hūm̐ cig tu bsam/ de'i steng la sogs par gang bsrung bar 'dod pa de'i ming gi yi ge dang po bsams te/ de'ang bla ma bsrung bar 'dod na steng du/ rang nyid nang du/ spun zla g.yon du/ pha ma mdun du/ bu dang chung ma g.yas su/ 'khor g.yog rgyab tu/ nor rdzas rnams 'og tu bsam/ gang mi bsrung ba'i sa stong par bzhag go /de nas 'khor lo'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi rtsibs med pa'i bar du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ gnod byed lus ring ma/ skra 'dzings pa/ kha nas khrag skyug pa/ spyi'u tshugs su 'dug par bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// gnod byed kyi shes pa bkug ste de la thim par bsam la/ rang gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur bas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo rnams zhal phyir gzigs/ dbus dang steng 'og gi khro bo rnams zhabs (132) g.yas brkyang*/ 'khor lo g.yon du myur tu 'khor bas/ gnod byed kyi lus rlung gis bskyod/ mes bsreg cing 'khor lo'i rtse mos gtubs pas/ kho'i tshe thogs med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyang nas/ rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsam shing sngags bzla'o/ /na maḥ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas sangs rgyas la sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/

na maḥ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas chos la sa man+ta dharmā ṇāṃ/ na maḥ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas dge 'dun la sa man+ta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ oṃ gdugs dkar po si tā ta pa tre/ oṃ dri ma dang bral ba bi ma la/ oṃ bde bar byed pa shaṅkar/ oṃ phyir zlog pa pra t+yaṃ gir/ badz+ra rdo rje gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba badz+ra.uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra wa rti/ sarba thams cad 'khrul 'khor yan+t+ra/ man+t+ra sngags/ mu rtsa ba'i las la karma/ ban+dhā bcing pa dang naṃ/ tā ḍa nāṃ/ brdeg pa dang*/ kī phur bus btab kyang rung la nāṃ wā/ ma bdag la byed pa dang ma kri te/ ye na gang ci yang rung ba ke na tsi ta/ kṛ byed pa de tan+ta ta/ sarbā n+tu/ thams cad/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ chod chod/ bhin+da bhin+da/ phug phug / tsi ri tsi ri/ phye mar gyis phye mar gyis/

gi ri gnon gnon gi ri/ ma ra sod sod ma ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces ci nus dang*/ spro na/ oṃ bha 'jigs pa nyams par byed ya nā sa ni/ trā sa skrag par byed ni/ sarba bdud thams cad phyir zlog par byed mā ra pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ bi rnam par nyams par byed nā sa ni/ ye gang ci yang rung ba ge tse ta/ duṣ+ṭān gdug pa'i sems can sa twa/ ma ma bdag la ngan par byed pa pi rū pa kaṃ kurban/ ti tā de dag dang ni/ sarba bdud thams cad phyir bzlog par phyis shig mā ra ṇi pra t+yaṃ kā ri ṇi sa ta tu hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'ang ci rigs bzlas la/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ bdag cag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa (133)rgya rnams dang*/ bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan par byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /gal te zhi bar ma gyur na de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o// ngag bcing bar bgyi'o// yid bcing bar bgyi'o// mthu brlag par gyur cig /rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig /stobs brlag par gyur cig /des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig /des bsgrub pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig / ces brjod cing lag mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje dang sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse gcig par bsam te/ gnod byed rnams de'i bar du brtsir bar bsams la thal mo brdab/ rang gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa du ma spros te gnod byed kyi lus dang dbang po thams cad rdul phra rab tu byas/ mes bsreg rlung gis tor bar bsam/ spro na/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi// lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlogs// rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol//

zhes brjod/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur bzhu ba las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdengs kha che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs ba lta bu/ chang zung dang mchog ma yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pa dang lte ba laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi bar snang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis (134)kyis mtha' rten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa de rnams 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim ste/ thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po// ljang gu/ dmar po// ser po// dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ slob dpon rin po che'i dgongs pa'o// rje btsun rin po che ltar na/ nang nas rim bzhin/ nag po// dkar po// ser po// dmar po// ljang gur bsgom/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/

sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang 'phan dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag gi dur khrod/ lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'bar ba'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du drag tu dgod pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu 'jigs byed mun pa/ nub byang du ki li ki li'i sgra sgrog pa/ de dag la gnas (135)pa'i shing chen po brgyad ni/ shar du shi ri sha*/lhor tsu ta/ nub tu kaṃ ka la/ byang du a shwat+tha/ byang shar du shing chen po// shar lhor ka rañdza/ lho nub tu 'khril shing can/ nub byang du a rdzun rnams so// shing de dag gi rtsa ba na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad ni/ shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa/ phyag g.yon na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang mdung 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na dbyu gu dang thod pa/ g.yon gnyis na spyi blugs dang phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa g.yon thod pa dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha sngon po ri dwags la zhon pa g.yon thod pa dang ba dan 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang phyag g.yas kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba'o// de dag gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin chen po brgyad ni/

shar du sgrogs byed ser po// lhor ldog byed sngon po// nub tu 'jigs byed dkar po// byang du 'khor byed ser po// byang shar du 'thug po dkar po// shar lhor 'gengs byed dmar po// lho nub tu char 'bebs sngon po// nub byang du gtum po sngon po'o// de dag la gnas pa'i klu chen po brgyad ni/ shar du nor rgyas ser po// lhor pad+ma dkar po// nub tu karka ṭa nag po// byang du 'jog po dmar po// byang shar du pad+ma (136)chen po dkar po// shar lhor hu lun+ta sngon po// lho nub tu rigs ldan ljang gu/ nub byang du dung skyong ser po thams cad kyang sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan zhing smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba'o// shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong ba brgyad ni/ shar du lha'i dge 'dun dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he'i gdong pa can/ nub tu sprin gyi rgyal po dmar po chu srin gyi gdong pa can/ byang du gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ser po rta'i gdong pa can/ byang shar du yi dwags 'dus pa dud ka glang gi gdong pa can/ shar lhor drang srong 'dus pa dmar po ra skyes kyi gdong pa can/ lho nub tu srin po'i tshogs can nag po ro langs kyi gdongs pa can/ nub byang du rlung gi rgyal po ljang gu ri dwags kyi gdong pa can/ thams cad kyang shing lo'i gseb nas snying ga yan chad 'thon pa/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o// gzhan yang ro mgo bo bcad pa dang*/ dpyangs pa dang*/ bsnyal ba dang*/ gsal shing gis phug pa dang*/ mgo bo dang*/ keng rus dang*/ lce spyang dang*/ khwa dang*/ 'ug pa dang*/ bya rgod dang*/ ro langs rnams phaiṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs pa/ ma lus pa rnams kyang sngon gyi grub pa thob pa rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa ste/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/

sha za dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ rjed byed dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ sgrub pa po rnams dang bcas pa'i dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngon po'i dbus sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma (137)brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo// tshangs pa ser po// dbang po dkar po// nye dbang sngon po// drag po nag po rnams steng nas steng du brtsigs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du tshangs pa ser po// lhor dbang po dkar po// nub tu nye dbang sngon po// byang du drag po nag po// byang shar du gshin rje sngon po// shar lhor nor bdag ser po// lho nub tu srin po nag po// nub byang du thag bzang ris dud ka rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta n+si la ya badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i rnam pa lta bu'i/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥphrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i phreng ba lta bu'i/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral bar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i g.yon du oṃ las gri gug sngo nag yu ba la oṃ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/

nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs (138)rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo// bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po// g.yas sngo// g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka /zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po// g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po// de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po// gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po// lnga pa na rnga mong thal ka /drug pa na mi dmar po// bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po// brgyad pa na byi bla gwa pa// g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po// gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po// bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po// drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po// bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po// brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po// dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyang pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid// de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ (139)g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/

mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang shing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la/ āḥs mtshan pa/ oṃ pad+ma pad+ma bde 'dzin pa ni/ su kha dha ra/ ma hā 'dod chags chen po'i bde ba ster rā ga su khan+da da/ tsa dga' bzhi'i skal pa sna tshogs pa/ tu rā nan+da bha ga bi shwa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kār+yaṃ bya ba mdzod cig bdag la'o ku ru ṣa me/ yab kyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje zhe sdang chen po ni ma hā dwe ṣa/ tsa tu rā nan+da ya kaḥ dga' bar mdzod cig bdag la'o/ kha ga mu kha ye/ mkha' 'gro'i gdong pa ro gcig mgon/ kā ra so nā tha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ bya ba mdzod cig bdag la'o/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgra ha ha si si kun durta badz+ra dhṛ+-i ka ces gsang gnas su grags pa'i sgras phyogs bcu'i bde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku: dbyibs brgyud drod rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pas thig le brgyad du gyur/ de rnams gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ zhes pa'i sa bon brgyad du gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu ba lha mo brgyad du gyur nas/ yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir 'thon te/ gdan so so'i steng du rim pa bzhin 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau rī nag po g.yas gri gug /g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu pe tā lī ser (140)mo g.yas rus sbal/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du gha sma rī ljang gu g.yas sbrul/

g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puk+ka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge /g.yon dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong*/ g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngo dmar g.yas 'khor lo// g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa// nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bar snang nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ dmar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam las yum gyi mkhar yi ges slebs pa'i rkyen gyis yab yum gnyis rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas/ bdud bzhi'i steng du bde ba chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gyi thig ler gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/

rang gi shes pa mtshams kyi lha mo bzhir 'phos te glus bskul bar bsams shing*/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig / puk+ka si ni bdag la skyobs// stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod// khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas// kyai yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la// ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod// dga' (141)gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba// stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci// khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas// gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid// bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyi// mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas// snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig / ces bskul bas/ thig le de nyid hūm̐ dang aṃ sngon po 'od 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/ de zhu ba las bdag nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po// g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon hūm̐ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ de rnams las 'od 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten la phog gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can la phog lha dgu'i ngo bor gyur/ thams cad kyi mig tu maṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo// rna bar dwaṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo// snar paṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo// khar raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo// dpral bar oṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying gar naṃ las bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo// spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo// mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo// thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo// thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang mi mgo skam po'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kye rdo rje (142)lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ dkar mo ri dgas sogs nas/ 'khyud pa nyid/ ces pas mchod/ spro na/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyis bstod/ khu tshur g.yon gyi mthe'u chung dang g.yas pa'i mdzub mo sbrel te/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dang*/ gau rī nag mo lcags kyu thogs pas srung 'khor gyi nang du spyan drangs/ khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad de zhags mig ltar byas la/ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ tsau rī dmar mo zhags pa thogs pas mgrin pa la reg pas ye shes pa rnams smin mtshams nas thim/ mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo phan tshun sbrel te oṃ badz+ra be tā lī bhan+dha bam̐/ zhes dang*/ be tā lī ser mo lcags sgrog thogs pas zhabs la reg pas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa 'dres/ khu tshur bcangs pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis bsnol te/ oṃ badz+ra gha sma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes dang*/ gha sma rī ljang gu dril bu thogs pas phyi nang kun tu dril bu'i sgra byung bas dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug /khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ gong ltar mchod/ spro na/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs// yid dang phrag dog chen po kun// rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mchog

/las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa// rdo rje can kun bdag dges mdzod// ces bstod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams he ru (143)ka'i gzugs su gyur nas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med// mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag pa rnam par snang mdzad brjod// ska rag sa ni don yod gnas// yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin mgon// dbang gi chu rgyun des mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo e las kyi phyag rgya/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo hūm̐ chos kyi phyag rgya/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo oṃ phyag rgya chen po// spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo haṃ dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ dbang gi chu rgyun des snying ga yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag /mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/

spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ dbang gi chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag /(144)chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang puk+ka si la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha wa ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ be tā lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ gha sma rī dang ḍaṃ bi nī la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ bdud rtsi dngos su 'byor ram bsams kyang rung ste/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥ sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho ྅ haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du shar du go las ba lang gi sha*/lhor ku las khyi'i sha /nub tu da las rta'i sha /byang du ha las glang po che'i sha /dbus su na las mi'i sha /sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang*/ shar du bh+rūṃ las dri chen/ lhor āṃ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bh+rūṃ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor āṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon skor gyis a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ oṃ āḥ g.yas skor gyis ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/

ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil (145)'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams skol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song bas/ oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag /yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje ljid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs te myang la/ lha rnams kyis ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas bde bas tshim par bsams te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swā dān badz+ra bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams shing*/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs nas 'khyud pa nyid/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ lha mo de rnams kyis bstod par bsams la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/

zhes de yan chad rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bsgoms la/ rten dang brten pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu la sems gzung*/ de la (146)brtan pa na rdzogs pa'i rim pa bla ma las ji ltar thob pa ltar nyams su blang ngo*// dag pa dran pa ni/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la// byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni// zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod// zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad// phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid// gug skyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid// de nyid gsum ni spyan gsum po// sha ni puk+ka sī ru brjod// de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma// gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod// g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag /pags pa byang chub yan lag bdun// rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid// ces brjod/ rgyas pa la spro na/ glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin smyo// khong skam mdze dang birdzi ka /mchin pa mtsher pa'i nad rnams la// glang po la sogs rim shes bya// sa ni dang po nor 'dzin mthar// dbang phyug brgyad ni stsol bar mdzad// spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa// zhes sogs gong ltar dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gau rī ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ tsau rī ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ be tā lī ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ ghasma rī ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes// puk+ka sī ni byams pa tshad med pa/ sha ba rī ni snying rje tshad med pa/ gdol pa mo ni dga' ba tshad med pa/ g.yung mo ni btang snyoms tshad med pa/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa/ dur khrod brgyad ni sna bug gcig tu bsdams pa'i lus kyi bu ga rnam par dag pa'o// gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te// tshor ba la ni dkar mor gshed// 'du shes chu yi rnal 'byor ma// 'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni// bdag med(147)rnal 'byor ma gnas so// sa ni puk+ka sī zhes brjod// chu khams rngon pa ma zhes brjod// me ni gtum mor shes par bya// rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu grags// zhe sdang zhes bshad rdo rje ma// 'dod chags chu yi rnal 'byor ma// phrag dog rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// ser sna gsang ba'i dkar mo nyid// gti mug de bzhin rdo rjer bshad// mig la gti mug rdo rje ma//

zhes sogs nas/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma// gzugs la dkar mor rtag tu bshad// sgra la chom rkun mar rab grags// dri yi cha la ro langs ma// ro la ghasma rī rab grags// reg las sa spyod ma zhes brjod// chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma// zhes brjod cing don yid la dran par bya'o// dag pa dran pa 'di 'og spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyi thog mar byas kyang nyes pa med do// bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ dus rgyun du dkyil 'khor bsdus nas gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis byas kyang gtub/ bsnyen pa la sogs pa'i tshe skabs 'di kho nar bya ste/ de yang yum gyi thugs ka'i oṃ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas 'thon yab kyi zhal du zhugs sku'i brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste yum gyi pad+mar zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs te rgyun mi 'chad par 'khor ba las/ las dang mthun pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas lha rnams dbang du 'dus par bsams la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i phreng ba bzung ste/ oṃ āṣ+ṭā dbang sngags brgyad pa'i zhal can la na nā ya/ piṅga lor+dha ke sha wa r+d+ma ne dmar ser dbu skra gyen brdzes la/ tsaturbing+sha ti nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i spyan ldan la ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya bcu drug pa yi phyag can la/ kriṣ+ṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ char sprin ltar gnas sku can la/ ka pāl mā lā ne kā dhā ri ṇe/ thod phreng du ma'i 'dzin pa la/ a dh+māta ma krūr tsit+tā (148)ya/ khong nas 'khrugs pa'i thugs can la/ ar+dhen+du daṃṣ+ṭī ṇe/ zla phyed lta bu'i mche gtsigs la/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ gsod cig gsod cig / kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gyis shig gyis shig gardza ya gardza ya/ sgrogs shig sgrogs shig tardza ya tardza ya/ rtogs shig rtogs shig sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sgoms shig sgoms shig / sap+ta sā ga rā na/ mtsho bdun rnams/ ban+dha ban+dha/ chings shig chings shig

/ nā gāṣ+ṭa kā na/ klu brgyad rnams/ grah+ṇa graṃh+ṇa/ zung shig zung shig / sha trūn/ dgra bo rnams/ ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ/ haḥ phaṭaḥswā hā/ bos shig legs pa sbyin/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lha 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ oṃ badz+ra kartā rdo rje gri gug kye rdo rje/ ri he badz+rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yab kyi rtsa sngags snying po nye snying ngo*// oṃ āḥ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ aṃ āḥ.aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥnam̐ badz+ra nai rāt+māya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

rnal 'byor ma rnams dang yum gyi'o// oṃ āḥgam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥgam̐ badz+ra gau rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥtsam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥtsam̐ badz+ra tsau rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbam̐/ rdo rje bdag med ma yi ched/ badz+ra be tā lī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥgham̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ badz+ra ghasma rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥsam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥsam̐ badz+ra puk+ka sī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥshaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥsham̐ badz+ra sha wa ri hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥlam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥlam̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ badz+ra ḍoṃ bi ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'khor gyi ste yab yum la ji tsam zlos pa'i bcu cha bzlas la/ thal mo sbyar te/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur tu phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub snying po kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ gong du dkyil 'khor ba bsdus na/ (149)rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad la/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la/ gzhal yas khang lha mo brgyad la/ lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la thim par ba bsam pa/ tho rang kyi thun ma yin pa'i thun gzhan gsum gyi rjes sam/ gtor ma dang 'brel na de'i rjes su/ kalpa krel+la'i ring gnas rdo rje dang a rā+eṭaṭhi a bo lā/ mum+mu mam+mu ni rag nas pad+ma'o ṇi re kak+ko lā/ gha kye rta tshogs su cang te'u dkrol ṇe kṛ biṭa ho i/ ka snying rjes ku tsa mi bya'o ru ṇe ki a i na ro lā/ ta de ru sha ri bza' bar bya

hiṃ ba la khādz+dzu.i/ gāṣaheṃ 'bad pas chang ni btung bar bya ma a ṇā bidz+dza i/ ha kye ho skal ldan gzhug par bya le kā liñdzar pa ṇi a i/ dun+tu skal med rnams ni spang bar bya ra bādz+dzi a a tsa bzhi mnyam kla tsi tu us ma kats+tshu rī si h+lā/ kā ga bur rnams ni byug par bya p+pu ra lā i a i/ mā tshod ma dang ni sha chen po la.in+dha ṇa sā liñdza/ ha hiṃ der ni mang du bza' bar bya bha ru kha i a i/ phre kha 'ong ba dang ni 'gro ba bya ṇa kha ṭa kar n+ta/ shud+dha dag dang ma dag dmigs mi bya a mu ṇi a i/ ni rus pa'i rgyan ni lus la gdags raṃ su aṃ ge tsa ḍā wi/ ta hiṃ dza der ni skyes pa'i ro bzhugs bya sa rā wa sa ṇi a i/ ma la 'du bar 'khrig la 'jug par bya a dze kun du ru pā ta i/ ḍi ṇ+ḍi ma ta hin+na bādz+dza a der ni reg min spang mi bya i/ zhes rdo rje'i glu blang*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin// de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis (150)mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin// zhes bkra shis brjod/ rigs su skye dang dam tshigs can// smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog

/sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gis lam gyis grol 'gyur pa// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog / ces smon lam btab/ spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis yul dang yul can thams cad lha'i 'khor lor shes par byas sdang zhen med par longs spyad/ kha zas za ba'i tshe kha zas la lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas bza' btung bdud rtsir bsams la/ snying ga'i hūm̐ lha thams cad kyi ngo bo mchod par mos shing chags zhen med par bza'/ lhag ma/ oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ zhes se gol gyi sgra dang bcas te lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin/ khyim pa yin na 'du shes gsum ldan gyi sgo nas rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor bya/ nyal ba'i tshe yum yab la/ yab kyi zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la/ de'ang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la/ khog pa mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ mthar nā da yang mi dmigs par bsams la 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i ngang du nyal/ tho rang gnyid sad pa na chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul gyis lha'i nga rgyal gyis langs la/ srod thun gyi rjes gyi rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis smon lam rnams bya/ khrus byed na dbang gi skabs ji lta ba bzhin nam/ rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyis ngag tu yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing bkrus pa/ mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor logs nas 'byung ba ltar byas te tho rangs kyi thun la 'jug la sogs gong bzhin du bya'o// de ltar rnal 'byor rnam la sa bcu bar ma chad (151)par nyams su blang na gnas skabs su grub mtha' rnams rim pas snyogs shing*/ mthar thug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o/ /khams drug yul drug 'gro drug dbang po drug
